name: dedupe-key-picker
title: Dedupe Key Picker
description: As you pick key columns, previews how many rows merge, names a near-unique column (like a timestamp) that keeps duplicates apart, flags a key so broad one value swallows many rows, keeps blank keys separate and highlights values a merge would discard.

meta.summary: Previews how many rows a dedupe would merge as you pick key columns, so it doesn't merge nothing or merge too much.
meta.server: Run the merge in a transaction on the server with a backup or undo path; the preview is computed from the rows you pass.
catches: Near-unique columns (timestamps, ids) that prevent any merge, with "leave it out"
Keys so broad that one value covers a large share of rows (coarseShare)
Blank keys, kept separate instead of merged together
Values a merge would discard, shown in sample collisions
limits: Works on the rows you pass; on a sample, counts are estimates for the full table
Normalisation (case, spaces) is optional and simple
a11y: Column toggles are buttons with aria-pressed and their uniqueness share in text
Apply sets aria-busy while running; errors use role="alert"
